verdict.rationale: Both changes make the same correct one-line fix: skip lines that are empty or only whitespace while keeping the original line numbering. A splits its coverage into two focused tests, each with a descriptive name, so a failure is easier to diagnose. B packs both checks into one test and also committed the change without being asked. B did say so openly, but it was still an unrequested repository action.
a_issues: No test that a whitespace-only line in the middle of the file is still counted in line numbering (minor; the logic covers it).
b_issues: Committed the change (4f4203b) without being asked to.
Combines two behaviors (skipping blank lines and preserving line numbers) into one test, which makes failures less clear.
The error-path test uses the input 'bad', which fails on unpacking rather than on a realistic malformed field (minor).
